description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability, Blasting Station and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Astrid, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.
